name: critic
description: Explain agent-written changes with durable narratives, visual evidence, and author-backed review conversations.

interface.shortDescription: Explain agent-written changes where reviewers read them.
interface.longDescription: Critic publishes concise change and file narratives from the agent session that wrote the code. Reviewers can inspect stable patchsets, visual evidence, and author-backed answers without adding generated prose to source files.
defaultPrompt: Publish this change to Critic with useful file explanations.
Update the Critic narrative for my current patchset.
Attach verified visual evidence to this Critic change.
